name: Oral History
abstract: An audio or video oral history recording or community narrative, modelled as a CIDOC-CRM E73 Information Object with a mandatory IIIF Presentation API manifest, interviewee reference, language, and consent status. Profiles ogc.heritage.digital-representation and adds schema.org AudioObject/VideoObject alignment for web visibility.

sources.title: HERITALISE D8.2 HM-07 (Audiovisual Media / Oral Histories)
